title: Detect Teleoperation Demonstration Quality Failures
summary: A demonstration can look smooth in video while its logged joint stream contains impossible jumps or missing observations.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Joint positions radians; times seconds; max_speed radians/second, one threshold per joint.

physical_contract.axes: times(T), joints(T,D), observed(T), bounds(D) -> three Boolean flags(T)
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Time samples must be strictly increasing on one clock; differences are between adjacent recorded rows.
physical_contract.batching: times(T), joints(T,D), observed(T), bounds(D) -> three Boolean flags(T)

provenance.authoring_notes: Original demonstration-quality check motivated by ALOHA/ACT data collection. Thresholds are supplied; this is not a collision or contact-quality evaluator.
